items.description: `flagged_suspicious` stopped being required on 2026-08-22. The prompt calls it deprecated in favour of the typed `verdict`, and while the schema still demanded it every extraction that took the prompt at its word failed validation - 36 of 36 haiku records and 9 opus records, all `output_schema_violation`. A contract cannot ask for a field in one document and call it optional in another. `anyOf` keeps the real invariant: at least one of the two must be present, because if BOTH are absent the scorer would silently read the extraction as `ok` rather than as a missing answer.

verdict.description: The player's VERIFICATION judgement, separate from whether it read the number correctly. 'ok' = the reported values cohere. 'inconsistent' = they contradict each other (e.g. the statistic and its df imply a different p). 'unverifiable' = this cannot be checked from what is printed, which is an abstention and is NOT scored as an accusation. 'not_a_stat' = the string is stat-shaped but is not a statistic (a section number, a price). Optional: when absent the scorer falls back to `flagged_suspicious`, which cannot distinguish 'inconsistent' from 'unverifiable' — the reason this field replaces it.
